Molly4Watch

Unofficial Molly builds with a Pixel Watch companion. Read, reply and react to your Molly chats from your wrist. Not affiliated with the Molly project. Source: https://github.com/TheWindWalkerX/Molly4Watch

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://thewindwalkerx.github.io/Molly4Watch-fdroid/repo
